profile.name: 合成轴仿真组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件模拟组件，源自 ophyd 的 sim 模块。其核心类 SynAxis 用于模拟一维可设定轴，例如位置轴或温度轴，并可配合合成信号、周期更新、伪 EPICS 信号和简单扫描/采集接口，用于实验控制程序、扫描流程和数据采集逻辑的测试与演示。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software simulation component derived from ophyd's sim module. Its core class, SynAxis, simulates a settable 1D axis such as position or temperature, and can be used with synthetic signals, periodic updates, fake EPICS-like signals, and simple scan/acquisition interfaces for testing and demonstrating experiment control, scan plans, and data acquisition logic.

registry.name: Synchrotron Axis
registry.description: 同步辐射光源实验站轴运动控制驱动，支持多轴联动扫描。
